ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/BACKLOG.md:30:| **B12** | S4 | A8 signal | **CLOSED** - mission-kit's A/A experiment was recorded before running, calibrated on a 450-cell run (F14, `2026-10-14-004707-aa`) and repeated on a second 450-cell run (F15, `2026-10-14-053958-aa`) with 0 persisting flags under `aa-gate`; M4.3 retains the further arm-guess and repeat checks (Delta-2 stage 5). **Repeatability is not tested.** No recorded experiment has been repeated and compared under its declared rule. | `[V, docs/ARCHITECTURE-TARGET.md section 8; docs/DELTAS/DELTA-2.md Record, stage 5]` | CLOSED - Delta-2 stage 5 (0024) |
ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/DELTAS/DELTA-2.md:41:- **The threshold deriver.** Its input is one A/A run: two identical arms, A and B, at nine runs per cell. For each scenario and member it pools the present cell runs of both arms - eighteen when none is excluded. A property's drop between two sets is standardised: `d = (rateA - rateB) / sqrt(2 p (1 - p) / n)`, `p` the property's rate over both sets together, `n` the outcomes per set, and `d = 0` where `p` is 0 or 1. For a size `k` of 3 or 9, with the generator the blinder uses seeded by the experiment's hash and `k`, it draws 1000 splits: for each, in sorted order of scenario and member, it shuffles that pool and takes the first `k'` runs as set A and the next `k'` as set B, where `k' = min(k, floor(n_pool / 2))`; every property uses the same split. Per split it takes the largest `d` over `m` properties - `m` declared by the comparison rule, by default every property the experiment holds. The threshold for size `k` is the nine-hundredth of the 1000 sorted largest values, and a drop flags only when strictly greater. It also reports, from nested splits whose first three runs per side form the size-3 sets, how often the two-stage rule below flags a persisting drop; and, as a drift check, where the actual arm A against arm B largest drop falls among the splits. It records `m`, the split count, the run id and both thresholds, and refuses a pool of fewer than twelve present runs.
ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/DELTAS/DELTA-2.md:44:- **The comparator.** Two arms of one result, or two results, under a declared rule: per-property tolerance, a property absent from the head or with no mean counted as a drop; the A/A rule - flag a property whose standardised drop exceeds the size-3 threshold, then, given results of base and head at nine runs supplied by the caller, report as persisting a flagged property whose drop at nine exceeds the size-9 threshold; or improve-without-worsening across families. It refuses inputs that differ in anything but the variant revisions under comparison - scenarios, population, runs per cell, trap assignment - and a threshold set whose `m` differs from the property count compared. Its output holds exactly `rule`, `inputs`, `flags`, `heldOut`, `exposed`, `limits`.
ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/DELTAS/DELTA-2.md:115:| F12 | 4 | On fixtures, each rule flags exactly the properties its definition in section 1 flags, including a property absent from the head or with no mean, and a flagged property persisting or not at size 9 read from a tally restricted to runs 1 to 3; the comparator refuses inputs differing in scenarios, population, runs per cell or trap assignment, and a threshold set of another `m`; its output's keys are exactly those section 1 lists. |
ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/DELTAS/DELTA-2.md:118:| F15 | 5 | A further run of the same recorded A/A experiment at the same pinned revision, started after F14's thresholds were recorded, is compared arm against arm under the A/A rule - cell runs 1 to 3 against the size-3 threshold, then flagged properties over all nine against the size-9 threshold - and the count of persisting flags is recorded; if it is above zero, the result states that the gate cannot tell a change from noise at this size, the falsifier of mission-kit's standing-suite design, section 12. |
ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/DELTAS/DELTA-2.md:157:**Settled at ratification (`0019`):** the gate's shape - one run with base and head as arms, as recommended and drafted, or two runs; the reading of mission-kit's gate rule as the largest standardised drop over `m` properties at the ninetieth percentile, a flag being one property or more, with persistence tested on nested sets; and the stated variation and default of the A/A and handoff experiments - 0.25 pooled, defaulting to no change indicated.
ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/DELTAS/DELTA-2.md:224:Also fixed from its findings: the A/A rule reads three runs in its first stage and nine for persistence, refusing other counts; a property absent from the head under the A/A rule persists when it is absent at nine too, so F15's count includes it; the deriver takes only a run of nine runs per cell, and `context-lab thresholds` refuses a comparison whose two arms deliver different things; the run command's flags are read by a tested function.\
ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/DELTAS/DELTA-2.md:251:Compared arm against arm (`on-trigger` vs `on-trigger-b`) under `aa-gate` (`COMPARE.json` in the run directory): 0 flags at size 3 and 0 persisting flags at size 9.\
ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/DELTAS/DELTA-2.md:270:| F15 satisfied either way, and citing a falsifier the architecture does not hold | blocking | Reworded to record the count of persisting flags and its consequence; citation corrected to mission-kit's design, section 12 |
ecb2f5f29d6aba8c58e9588d34b677b516ef03d8:docs/DELTAS/DELTA-3.md:135:- **Code quote check is surface-level, and applies between stage 1 and stage 2.** Checking that `words(quote)` is 1-25 words and a subset of `words(outcome)` catches fabricated words and over-long quotes before spending verifier calls; it does not check whether the quote supports the finding in context, which is the stage-2 verifier's job.
